<issue>Issue Title: [Bug]: ReActAgent exits loop prematurely when LLM returns only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use)
Description:
**<u>AgentScope is an open-source project. To involve a broader community, we recommend asking your questions in English.</u>**
**Describe the bug**
In _react_agent.py, the main ReAct loop's exit condition (around line 514) only checks for the absence of tool_use blocks:
```python
elif not msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("tool_use"):
# Exit the loop when no structured output is required (or
# already satisfied) and only text response is generated
msg_reasoning.metadata = structured_output
reply_msg = msg_reasoning
break
```
This assumes that if there's no tool_use, the response must contain text. However, when using models with extended thinking (e.g., Claude with thinking enabled, Qwen with thinking enabled), the LLM may return a response containing only thinking blocks — no text and no tool_use.
In this case, not has_content_blocks("tool_use") evaluates to True, causing the loop to break and return msg_reasoning as the final reply — which contains no user-visible text content, effectively producing an empty response.
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1、Use a model with extended thinking enabled (e.g., Claude 3.5/4 with thinking capability, or Qwen with thinking mode)
2、Send a complex query that triggers extensive reasoning
3、In some iterations, the model returns only a thinking block without text or tool_use
4、The agent incorrectly breaks out of the loop, returning an empty/thinking-only reply
**Expected behavior**
When the LLM response contains only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use), the agent should continue the loop instead of breaking out, allowing the LLM another iteration to produce actual text or tool calls.
```python
elif not msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("tool_use"):
# Only exit if there's actual text content for the user
if msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("text"):
msg_reasoning.metadata = structured_output
reply_msg = msg_reasoning
break
# else: only thinking blocks present, continue the loop
```

Model: Any model with thinking/extended_thinking support (qwen3.6-flash, etc.)
Python: 3.12

none

696                 (
697                     UserConfirmResultEvent,
698                     UserInterruptEvent,
699                     ExternalExecutionResultEvent,
700                 ),
701             ):
702                 event = inputs
703                 msgs = None
704             else:
705                 event = None
706                 msgs = inputs
707 
708             # Parked-interrupt short-circuit: only signal an INTERRUPTED
709             # end when there is actual HITL work to close; otherwise the
710             # session is effectively idle and the call is a silent no-op.
711             # ``finally`` reuses the CancelledError cleanup path when
712             # ``end_event`` is set — no reasoning-acting loop either way.
713             if isinstance(inputs, UserInterruptEvent):
714                 if self.state.has_awaiting_tool_calls(self.name):
715                     end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
716                         session_id=self.state.session_id,
717                         reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
718                         finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.INTERRUPTED,
719                     )
720                 return
721 
722             # ===================================================================
723             # Step 1: Checking agent input:
724             #  - if incoming event and agent is waiting for an event
725             #  - if event is None and agent is not waiting for an event
726             # ===================================================================
727             is_awaiting = await self._check_incoming_event(event)
728 
729             # ===================================================================
730             # Step 2: Handling agent event if applicable
731             #  - yield tool result events for the denied tool calls, or
732             #  - update the reply state as a new reply process
733             # ===================================================================
734             if is_awaiting:
735                 async for evt in self._handle_incoming_event(event):
736                     yield evt
737             else:
738                 await self._handle_incoming_messages(msgs)
739                 # Update the context with the incoming message and state
740                 self.state.reply_id = _generate_id()
741                 self.state.cur_iter = 0
742 
743                 yield ReplyStartEvent(
744                     session_id=self.state.session_id,
745                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
746                     name=self.name,
747                 )
748 
749             # =================================================================
750             # Step 3: Enter the reasoning-acting loop until reaching max_iters
751             #  or no more tool calls to execute
752             # =================================================================
753             while self.state.cur_iter < self.react_config.max_iters:
754                 # =============================================================
755                 # Step 3.1:
756                 # =============================================================
757                 action, data = self._check_next_action()
758                 if action == "exit" and isinstance(data, Msg):
759                     yield data
760                     return
761 
762                 # =============================================================
763                 # Step 3.2: Execute reasoning if no more tools to be executed
764                 # =============================================================
765                 if action == "reasoning":
766                     # Compressed the memory if needed before reasoning
767                     await self.compress_context()
768 
769                     # Perform reasoning
770                     interrupted = False
771                     async for evt in self._reasoning():
772                         # Exit the loop when no tool calls generated and the
773                         # reply message is generated
774                         if isinstance(evt, Msg):
775                             end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
776                                 session_id=self.state.session_id,
777                                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
778                                 finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.COMPLETED,
779                             )
780                             yield evt
781                             return
782 
783                         elif isinstance(evt, ModelCallEndEvent):
784                             interrupted = (
785                                 evt.finished_reason
786                                 == FinishedReason.INTERRUPTED
787                             )
788 
789                         yield evt
790 
791                     if interrupted:
792                         end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
793                             session_id=self.state.session_id,
794                             reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
795                             finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.INTERRUPTED,
796                         )
797                         return
798 
799                 # =============================================================
800                 # Step 3.3: Getting batches of tool calls to be executed
801                 #  - If not, finish loop by yielding RunFinishedEvent and exit
802                 #  - Otherwise, execute by batch and continue the loop
803                 # =============================================================
804                 for batch in await self._batch_tool_calls():
805                     if batch.type == "sequential":
806                         evt_generator = self._execute_sequential_tool_calls(
807                             batch.tool_calls,
808                         )
809 
810                     elif batch.type == "concurrent":
811                         evt_generator = self._execute_concurrent_tool_calls(
812                             batch.tool_calls,
813                         )
814 
815                     else:
816                         raise ValueError(
817                             f"Invalid batch type: {batch.type}",
818                         )
819 
820                     break_execution_for_hitl = False
821                     break_execution_for_interruption = False
822                     break_message = ""
823                     async for evt in evt_generator:
824                         yield evt
825                         if isinstance(
826                             evt,
827                             (
828                                 RequireUserConfirmEvent,
829                                 RequireExternalExecutionEvent,
830                             ),
831                         ):
832                             break_execution_for_hitl = True
833                             break_message = (
834                                 "Waiting for tool calls to be confirmed or "
835                                 "executed from outside ..."
836                             )
837 
838                         elif (
839                             isinstance(evt, ToolResultEndEvent)
840                             and evt.state == ToolResultState.INTERRUPTED
841                         ):
842                             # Handle the interruption event
843                             break_execution_for_interruption = True
844 
845                     if break_execution_for_interruption:
846                         end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
847                             session_id=self.state.session_id,
848                             reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
849                             finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.INTERRUPTED,
850                         )
851                         return
852 
853                     # If it requires outside interaction stop executing the
854                     # next batch and wait for outside trigger events
855                     if break_execution_for_hitl:
856                         yield AssistantMsg(
857                             id=self.state.reply_id,
858                             name=self.name,
859                             content=break_message,
860                         )
861                         return
862 
863                 # Update iteration count after each round of reasoning-acting
864                 self.state.cur_iter += 1
865 
866             # =================================================================
867             # Step 4: Handling the max iteration executed
868             # =================================================================
869             yield ExceedMaxItersEvent(
870                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
871                 name=self.name,
872             )
873             logger.warning(
874                 "Agent %s exceeds the max iteration numbers %d. "
875                 "Stop the react loop.",
876                 self.name,
877                 self.react_config.max_iters,
878             )
879 
880             # Mirror the normal-exit path so subscribers (e.g. SSE clients
881             # waiting on a terminal event) don't hang when the loop bails
882             # out on max_iters.
883             end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
884                 session_id=self.state.session_id,
885                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
886                 finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.EXCEED_MAX_ITERS,
887             )
888 
889             yield AssistantMsg(
890                 id=self.state.reply_id,
891                 name=self.name,
892                 content="Executed maximum iterations of reasoning-acting loop "
893                 "without finishing the task.",
894             )
895 
896         except asyncio.CancelledError:
897             # Handle the CancelledError within the _reply_impl for the
898             # agent middlewares
899             end_event = ReplyEndEvent(
900                 session_id=self.state.session_id,
901                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
902                 finished_reason=ReplyEndReason.INTERRUPTED,
903             )
904 
905             if self.react_config.interruption_raise_cancelled_error:
906                 raise
907 
908         finally:
909             if end_event is not None:
910                 if end_event.finished_reason == ReplyEndReason.INTERRUPTED:
911                     # Handle the context when interruption
912                     async for _ in self._close_unfinished_tool_calls():
913                         yield _
914 
915                     # A fallback msg object
916                     yield AssistantMsg(
917                         id=self.state.reply_id,
918                         name=self.name,
919                         content=self.react_config.interruption_message,
920                     )
921 
922                 yield end_event

1123     async def _check_incoming_event(
1124         self,
1125         event: UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent | None,
1126     ) -> bool:
1127         """Check if the agent is waiting for the incoming event, if no, raise
1128         error.
1129 
1130         Args:
1131             event (`UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent \
1132             | None`):
1133                 The incoming event to be checked.
1134 
1135         Raises:
1136             `ValueError`:
1137                 If the agent is not waiting for the incoming event, or the
1138                 event is not valid.
1139 
1140         Returns:
1141             `bool`:
1142                 If the agent is waiting for the incoming event, that means
1143                 this reply calling continues from the previous one. If not,
1144                 the reply id and iteration count should be updated for the new
1145                 reply.
1146         """
1147         awaiting_confirmations = []
1148         awaiting_external_executions = []
1149 
1150         last_msg = self._get_last_msg()
1151         if last_msg:
1152             # The completed tool call ids
1153             tool_result_ids = [
1154                 _.id for _ in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_result")
1155             ]
1156 
1157             for tool_call in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_call"):
1158                 if tool_call.state == ToolCallState.ASKING:
1159                     awaiting_confirmations.append(tool_call.id)
1160                 elif (
1161                     tool_call.state == ToolCallState.SUBMITTED
1162                     and tool_call.id not in tool_result_ids
1163                 ):
1164                     # submitted but no result yet, i.e. external execution
1165                     awaiting_external_executions.append(tool_call.id)
1166 
1167         # No incoming event but needed
1168         if event is None and (
1169             awaiting_confirmations or awaiting_external_executions
1170         ):
1171             raise ValueError(
1172                 f"Agent is waiting for {len(awaiting_confirmations)} tool "
1173                 f"calls and external execution results for "
1174                 f"{len(awaiting_external_executions)} tool calls, "
1175                 f"but received no event.",
1176             )
1177 
1178         if isinstance(event, UserConfirmResultEvent):
1179             if not awaiting_confirmations:
1180                 raise ValueError(
1181                     f"Agent is not waiting for user confirmation, "
1182                     f"but received UserConfirmResultEvent: {event}",
1183                 )
1184 
1185             # Given event, required but not match
1186             extra_ids = set(
1187                 _.tool_call.id for _ in event.confirm_results
1188             ) - set(awaiting_confirmations)
1189             if extra_ids:
1190                 raise ValueError(
1191                     f"Received UserConfirmResultEvent with tool call ids "
1192                     f"{extra_ids} that are not waiting for confirmation.",
1193                 )
1194 
1195         if isinstance(event, ExternalExecutionResultEvent):
1196             if not awaiting_external_executions:
1197                 raise ValueError(
1198                     f"Agent is not waiting for external execution result, "
1199                     f"but received ExternalExecutionResultEvent: {event}",
1200                 )
1201 
1202             extra_ids = set(_.id for _ in event.execution_results) - set(
1203                 awaiting_external_executions,
1204             )
1205             if extra_ids:
1206                 raise ValueError(
1207                     f"Received ExternalExecutionResultEvent with tool call "
1208                     f"ids {extra_ids} that are not waiting for external "
1209                     f"execution results.",
1210                 )
1211 
1212         return event is not None
1213 
1214     async def _handle_incoming_event(
1215         self,
1216         event: UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent | None,
1217     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1218         ToolResultStartEvent
1219         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1220         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1221         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1222         None,
1223     ]:
1224         """Handle the incoming event and update the context accordingly.
1225 
1226         Args:
1227             event (`UserConfirmResultEvent | ExternalExecutionResultEvent \
1228             | None`):
1229                 The incoming event to be handled.
1230 
1231         Yields:
1232             `ToolResultStartEvent \
1233             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1234             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1235             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1236                 The events generated during the handling of the incoming event.
1237         """
1238         # Return directly if no event
1239         if event is None or len(self.state.context) == 0:
1240             return
1241 
1242         if isinstance(event, UserConfirmResultEvent):
1243             # The confirmed tool calls
1244             confirmed_tool_calls = {
1245                 _.tool_call.id: _ for _ in event.confirm_results
1246             }
1247 
1248             # Update the state with the confirmed tool calls
1249             last_msg = self.state.context[-1]
1250             for tool_call in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_call"):
1251                 if len(confirmed_tool_calls) == 0:
1252                     break
1253 
1254                 if tool_call.id in confirmed_tool_calls:
1255                     confirmation = confirmed_tool_calls[tool_call.id]
1256                     if confirmation.confirmed:
1257                         # Update state and wait for execution in the next step
1258                         self._update_tool_call_state(
1259                             tool_call.id,
1260                             ToolCallState.ALLOWED,
1261                         )
1262 
1263                         # Update name and  input in case user modification is
1264                         # allowed
1265                         tool_call.name = confirmation.tool_call.name
1266                         tool_call.input = confirmation.tool_call.input
1267 
1268                         # Update the permission rule if accepted
1269                         if confirmation.rules:
1270                             for rule in confirmation.rules:
1271                                 self._engine.add_rule(rule)
1272 
1273                     else:
1274                         # Update the state to deny and handling
1275                         async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
1276                             tool_call,
1277                             message=(
1278                                 "<system-reminder>The execution of tool "
1279                                 f'"{tool_call.name}" is denied by user!'
1280                                 "</system-reminder>"
1281                             ),
1282                             state=ToolResultState.DENIED,
1283                         ):
1284                             yield evt
1285 
1286                     # Delete for quick lookup and later processing
1287                     confirmed_tool_calls.pop(tool_call.id)
1288 
1289         elif isinstance(event, ExternalExecutionResultEvent):
1290             # Directly append the execution results into context
1291             for tool_result in event.execution_results:
1292                 async for evt in self._convert_tool_chunk_to_event(
1293                     tool_result.id,
1294                     tool_result.output,
1295                 ):
1296                     yield evt
1297 
1298                 yield ToolResultEndEvent(
1299                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1300                     tool_call_id=tool_result.id,
1301                     state=tool_result.state,
1302                     metadata=tool_result.metadata,
1303                 )
1304 
1305                 self._save_to_context([tool_result])
1306 
1307                 # Update the state according to the execution result state
1308                 self._update_tool_call_state(
1309                     tool_result.id,
1310                     ToolCallState.FINISHED,
1311                 )
1312 
1313         else:
1314             raise ValueError(f"Invalid event type: {event}")
1315

1344     async def _batch_tool_calls(self) -> list[_ToolCallBatch]:
1345         """Batch the tool calls into a sequence of batches that should be
1346         executed **sequentially** or **concurrently** according to the tool
1347         properties `is_concurrency_safe` and `is_read_only`.
1348         """
1349         # All tool calls that haven't the corresponding results in the context
1350         tool_calls = self._get_executable_tool_calls()
1351 
1352         # Batch the tool calls according to whether they can be executed
1353         # concurrently or not
1354         batches: list[_ToolCallBatch] = []
1355         for tool_call in tool_calls:
1356             tool = await self.toolkit.get_tool(tool_call.name)
1357 
1358             # Treat unregistered or unavailable tools as concurrent tools since
1359             # it will not generate side effects and be blocked with acting
1360             if tool is None or tool.is_concurrency_safe:
1361                 if len(batches) == 0 or batches[-1].type != "concurrent":
1362                     batches.append(
1363                         _ToolCallBatch(
1364                             type="concurrent",
1365                             tool_calls=[tool_call],
1366                         ),
1367                     )
1368                 else:
1369                     batches[-1].tool_calls.append(tool_call)
1370             else:
1371                 if len(batches) == 0 or batches[-1].type != "sequential":
1372                     batches.append(
1373                         _ToolCallBatch(
1374                             type="sequential",
1375                             tool_calls=[tool_call],
1376                         ),
1377                     )
1378                 else:
1379                     batches[-1].tool_calls.append(tool_call)
1380 
1381         return batches

1383     async def _execute_sequential_tool_calls(
1384         self,
1385         tool_calls: list[ToolCallBlock],
1386     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1387         RequireUserConfirmEvent
1388         | RequireExternalExecutionEvent
1389         | ToolResultStartEvent
1390         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1391         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1392         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1393         None,
1394     ]:
1395         """Execute the given tool calls sequentially and yield the events.
1396 
1397         If "RequireUserConfirmEvent" or "RequireExternalExecutionEvent" is
1398         yielded during the execution, the execution will be paused in the
1399         sequential mode and wait for the outside trigger events.
1400 
1401         Args:
1402             tool_calls (`list[ToolCallBlock]`):
1403                 The tool calls to be executed sequentially.
1404 
1405         Yields:
1406             `RequireUserConfirmEvent \
1407             | RequireExternalExecutionEvent \
1408             | ToolResultStartEvent \
1409             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1410             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1411             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1412                 The events generated during the execution of the tool calls.
1413         """
1414         break_execution = False
1415         for tool_call in tool_calls:
1416             async for evt in self._execute_tool_call(tool_call):
1417                 yield evt
1418                 if isinstance(
1419                     evt,
1420                     (
1421                         RequireUserConfirmEvent,
1422                         RequireExternalExecutionEvent,
1423                     ),

1425                     isinstance(evt, ToolResultEndEvent)
1426                     and evt.state == ToolResultState.INTERRUPTED

1433     async def _execute_concurrent_tool_calls(
1434         self,
1435         tool_calls: list[ToolCallBlock],
1436     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1437         RequireUserConfirmEvent
1438         | RequireExternalExecutionEvent
1439         | ToolResultStartEvent
1440         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1441         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1442         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1443         None,
1444     ]:
1445         """Execute the given tool calls concurrently and yield the events.
1446 
1447         All tool calls are executed concurrently. If one or more tool calls
1448         fail, the remaining ones are **not** cancelled and will run to
1449         completion. After all tool calls finish, every exception is collected
1450         and re-raised together as an :py:exc:`ExceptionGroup` so the caller
1451         can inspect each failure individually.
1452 
1453         The event stream is guaranteed to be complete: the loop exits only
1454         after a sentinel value placed by the gather task is received, which
1455         means every ``queue.put`` from every worker has already finished
1456         before the generator returns.
1457 
1458         If the caller task is cancelled from outside, the concurrent worker
1459         tasks are cancelled explicitly (to avoid orphan tasks), any events
1460         already queued by the workers (including interruption chunks emitted
1461         by ``toolkit.call_tool`` when it catches ``CancelledError``) are
1462         flushed to the caller, and the generator returns normally. The
1463         caller is expected to detect the interruption via the flushed
1464         ``ToolResultEndEvent(state=INTERRUPTED)`` events, mirroring the
1465         event-based propagation used by
1466         :meth:`_execute_sequential_tool_calls`.
1467 
1468         Args:
1469             tool_calls (`list[ToolCallBlock]`):
1470                 The tool calls to be executed concurrently.
1471 
1472         Yields:
1473             `RequireUserConfirmEvent \
1474             | RequireExternalExecutionEvent \
1475             | ToolResultStartEvent \
1476             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1477             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1478             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1479                 The events generated during the execution of the tool calls.
1480 
1481         Raises:
1482             `ExceptionGroup`:
1483                 Raised after all tool calls finish when one or more of them
1484                 raised an exception. Each individual exception is included in
1485                 the group.
1486         """
1487         # A sentinel object that signals all worker tasks have finished and
1488         # all events have already been put into the queue.
1489         sentinel = object()
1490 
1491         # Create a queue to collect events from all concurrent workers.
1492         queue: Queue = Queue()
1493 
1494         # Batch-shared accumulator for confirmation de-duplication: the
1495         # suggested rules of every confirmation surfaced by this batch are
1496         # collected here so a later call already covered by an earlier
1497         # call's rule is not prompted a second time. Mutated only from
1498         # synchronous sections of the workers, so no lock is needed on the
1499         # single-threaded event loop.
1500         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] = []
1501 
1502         async def _run_all() -> list[BaseException | None]:
1503             """Run all tool calls concurrently and push the sentinel when done.
1504 
1505             Returns:
1506                 `list[BaseException | None]`:
1507                     One entry per tool call. Each entry is either ``None``
1508                     (success) or the exception raised by that tool call.
1509             """
1510             # return_exceptions=True keeps all tasks running even when some
1511             # fail, and returns exceptions as values instead of re-raising.
1512             results = await asyncio.gather(
1513                 *[
1514                     self._into_queue(tc, queue, kept_rules)
1515                     for tc in tool_calls
1516                 ],
1517                 return_exceptions=True,
1518             )
1519             # The sentinel is placed AFTER gather returns, which guarantees
1520             # that every queue.put inside _into_queue has already completed.
1521             await queue.put(sentinel)
1522             return results  # type: ignore[return-value]
1523 
1524         gather_task = asyncio.create_task(_run_all())
1525 
1526         try:
1527             # Drain the queue until the sentinel is encountered.
1528             while True:
1529                 event = await queue.get()
1530                 if event is sentinel:
1531                     break
1532                 yield event
1533         except asyncio.CancelledError:
1534             # Cancel the gather tasks, which will be handled within the toolkit
1535             gather_task.cancel()
1536             try:
1537                 await gather_task
1538             except asyncio.CancelledError:
1539                 pass
1540             while True:
1541                 try:
1542                     event = queue.get_nowait()
1543                 except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
1544                     break
1545                 if event is sentinel:
1546                     continue
1547                 yield event
1548             # Consume the cancel so this generator returns normally. The
1549             # caller relies on the flushed ``ToolResultEndEvent(state=
1550             # INTERRUPTED)`` events, not on the exception, to detect the
1551             # interruption — mirroring the event-based propagation used by
1552             # :meth:`_execute_sequential_tool_calls`.
1553             asyncio.current_task().uncancel()
1554             return
1555 
1556         # All tasks are done at this point; collect and re-raise exceptions.
1557         results = await gather_task
1558         exceptions = [r for r in results if isinstance(r, Exception)]
1559         if exceptions:
1560             raise ExceptionGroup(
1561                 "One or more tool calls raised an exception",
1562                 exceptions,
1563             )
1564 
1565     async def _into_queue(
1566         self,
1567         tool_call: ToolCallBlock,
1568         queue: Queue,
1569         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] | None = None,
1570     ) -> None:
1571         """Execute a single tool call and forward every event into *queue*.
1572 
1573         Args:
1574             tool_call (`ToolCallBlock`):
1575                 The tool call to execute.
1576             queue (`Queue`):
1577                 The shared async queue that collects events from all
1578                 concurrent workers.
1579             kept_rules (`list[PermissionRule] | None`, defaults to `None`):
1580                 The batch-shared accumulator of already-surfaced suggested
1581                 rules, forwarded to :meth:`_execute_tool_call` for
1582                 confirmation de-duplication within the concurrent batch.
1583         """
1584         async for evt in self._execute_tool_call(tool_call, kept_rules):
1585             await queue.put(evt)

1587     async def _execute_tool_call(
1588         self,
1589         tool_call: ToolCallBlock,
1590         kept_rules: list[PermissionRule] | None = None,
1591     ) -> AsyncGenerator[
1592         RequireUserConfirmEvent
1593         | RequireExternalExecutionEvent
1594         | ToolResultStartEvent
1595         | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent
1596         | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent
1597         | ToolResultEndEvent,
1598         None,
1599     ]:
1600         """Execute a single tool call with permission checking and context
1601         management.
1602 
1603         This method handles the full tool call lifecycle: input validation,
1604         permission checking, event emission, and context writes.  The raw
1605         tool execution (``toolkit.call_tool``) is delegated to
1606         :meth:`_acting`, which is the hook point for ``on_acting``
1607         middleware.
1608 
1609         Args:
1610             tool_call (`ToolCallBlock`):
1611                 The tool call block to be executed.
1612             kept_rules (`list[PermissionRule] | None`, defaults to `None`):
1613                 A batch-scoped, shared accumulator of the suggested rules
1614                 already surfaced by earlier confirmations in the same
1615                 concurrent batch. Passed only by
1616                 :meth:`_execute_concurrent_tool_calls`; when provided, a
1617                 non-safety ASK whose invocation is already covered by an
1618                 accumulated rule is de-duplicated (left ``PENDING`` and
1619                 not surfaced again). ``None`` disables de-duplication
1620                 (e.g. sequential execution, which already parks at the
1621                 first ASK).
1622 
1623         Yields:
1624             `RequireUserConfirmEvent \
1625             | RequireExternalExecutionEvent \
1626             | ToolResultStartEvent \
1627             | ToolResultTextDeltaEvent \
1628             | ToolResultDataDeltaEvent \
1629             | ToolResultEndEvent`:
1630                 The events generated during the tool call execution.
1631         """
1632         # ===================================================================
1633         # Step 1: Check and parse the tool call input:
1634         #  - if failed, directly return the error message to the agent
1635         #  - if success, continue to permission checking and tool execution
1636         # ===================================================================
1637         try:
1638             # Check if the tool is available
1639             tool = await self.toolkit.check_tool_available(
1640                 tool_call.name,
1641                 self.state.tool_context.activated_groups,
1642             )
1643 
1644             # Try to parse the input with the tool schema
1645             parsed_input = _json_loads_with_repair(
1646                 tool_call.input,
1647                 tool.input_schema,
1648             )
1649 
1650             # Validate the parsed input with the tool schema
1651             # TODO: Maybe some logic to mix the validation error in runtime
1652             try:
1653                 jsonschema.validate(parsed_input, tool.input_schema)
1654             except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
1655                 raise AgentOrientedException(
1656                     f"Input validation failed for tool '{tool_call.name}': "
1657                     f"{e.message}",
1658                 ) from e
1659 
1660         # The exceptions that
1661         #  - cannot found tool
1662         #  - tool not available
1663         #  - input parsing failure
1664         except AgentOrientedException as e:
1665             async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
1666                 tool_call,
1667                 e.message,
1668                 state=ToolResultState.ERROR,
1669             ):
1670                 yield evt
1671 
1672             return
1673 
1674         # ===================================================================
1675         # Step 2: Check permission by toolkit and permission engine
1676         # ===================================================================
1677         if tool_call.state == ToolCallState.ALLOWED:
1678             # Already allowed by user confirmation, skip permission checking
1679             decision = PermissionDecision(
1680                 behavior=PermissionBehavior.ALLOW,
1681                 message="Already allowed by user confirmation.",
1682             )
1683         else:
1684             decision = await self._engine.check_permission(
1685                 tool,
1686                 parsed_input,
1687             )
1688 
1689         # ===================================================================
1690         # Step 3: Handle the permission and execute the tool call if allowed
1691         # ===================================================================
1692 
1693         # Case 1: Ask for user confirmation if needed
1694         if decision.behavior in [
1695             PermissionBehavior.ASK,
1696             PermissionBehavior.PASSTHROUGH,
1697         ]:
1698             # Batch de-duplication (concurrent batches only): if an earlier
1699             # confirmation in this same batch already suggested an allow rule
1700             # that matches this invocation, do not surface a second prompt.
1701             # Leave the call PENDING so the next reply run re-evaluates it
1702             # against the engine once the user answers the first prompt (and
1703             # its rule has been added). Safety ASKs (bypass-immune) are never
1704             # de-duplicated — an allow rule cannot clear them, so each must
1705             # surface its own prompt.
1706             is_safety_ask = (
1707                 decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.ASK
1708                 and decision.bypass_immune
1709             )
1710             if kept_rules is not None and not is_safety_ask:
1711                 for rule in kept_rules:
1712                     if rule.tool_name != tool.name:
1713                         continue
1714                     if await _execute_async_or_sync_func(
1715                         tool.match_rule,
1716                         rule.rule_content,
1717                         parsed_input,
1718                     ):
1719                         # Covered by an earlier call's rule; stay PENDING and
1720                         # do not yield — re-evaluated on the next reply run.
1721                         return
1722 
1723             if kept_rules is not None:
1724                 # Register this prompt's suggested rules so later calls in the
1725                 # batch can be de-duplicated against them.
1726                 kept_rules.extend(decision.suggested_rules or [])
1727 
1728             # Set the state of the tool call to "ask"
1729             # **Note** the update must be done before yielding the event
1730             self._update_tool_call_state(
1731                 tool_call.id,
1732                 ToolCallState.ASKING,
1733             )
1734 
1735             tool_call.suggested_rules = decision.suggested_rules or []
1736             yield RequireUserConfirmEvent(
1737                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1738                 tool_calls=[tool_call],
1739             )
1740             return
1741 
1742         # Case 2: Denied by the permission system
1743         if decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.DENY:
1744             async for evt in self._handle_error_tool_call(
1745                 tool_call,
1746                 decision.message,
1747                 state=ToolResultState.DENIED,
1748             ):
1749                 yield evt
1750 
1751             return
1752 
1753         # Case 3: Allowed by the permission system, execute the tool call and
1754         #  yield the events
1755         if decision.behavior == PermissionBehavior.ALLOW:
1756             self._update_tool_call_state(
1757                 tool_call.id,
1758                 ToolCallState.ALLOWED,
1759             )
1760             # Send start event
1761             yield ToolResultStartEvent(
1762                 reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1763                 tool_call_id=tool_call.id,
1764                 tool_call_name=tool_call.name,
1765             )
1766             # Send requiring external execution event if it's an external tool
1767             if tool.is_external_tool:
1768                 # Update the state to "submitted" BEFORE yielding
1769                 # because the outer loop will break immediately after
1770                 # receiving this event, preventing any code after yield
1771                 # from executing
1772                 self._update_tool_call_state(
1773                     tool_call.id,
1774                     ToolCallState.SUBMITTED,
1775                 )
1776                 yield RequireExternalExecutionEvent(
1777                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1778                     tool_calls=[tool_call],
1779                 )
1780                 return
1781 
1782             # ================================================================
1783             # Step 4: Delegate raw execution to _acting (middleware hook point)
1784             # ================================================================
1785             async for chunk in self._acting(tool_call):
1786                 # The ToolResponse is the last and completed tool result here
1787                 if isinstance(chunk, ToolResponse):
1788                     tool_result_block = ToolResultBlock(
1789                         id=tool_call.id,
1790                         name=tool_call.name,
1791                         output=[TextBlock(text=chunk.content)]
1792                         if isinstance(chunk.content, str)
1793                         else chunk.content,
1794                         state=chunk.state,
1795                         metadata=chunk.metadata,
1796                     )
1797 
1798                     # ========================================================
1799                     # Step 5: Truncate the tool result if exceed
1800                     # ========================================================
1801                     (
1802                         reserved_tool_result_block,
1803                         offload_tool_result_block,
1804                     ) = await self._split_tool_result_for_compression(
1805                         tool_result_block,
1806                     )
1807 
1808                     # If offload result is not empty, attach reminder to the
1809                     # reserved context
1810                     if offload_tool_result_block is not None:
1811                         reminder = (
1812                             "\n<<<TRUNCATED>>>\n<system-reminder>The "
1813                             "remaining content has been omitted for "
1814                             "limited context.{offload_reminder}"
1815                             "</system-reminder>"
1816                         )
1817 
1818                         offload_reminder = ""
1819                         if self.offloader:
1820                             path = await self.offloader.offload_tool_result(
1821                                 self.state.session_id,
1822                                 offload_tool_result_block,
1823                             )
1824 
1825                             offload_reminder = (
1826                                 f" You can refer to the file in '{path}' "
1827                                 f"for the truncated content if needed."
1828                             )
1829 
1830                         reminder = reminder.format(
1831                             offload_reminder=offload_reminder,
1832                         )
1833 
1834                         # Insert the reminder to the tool result output
1835                         if isinstance(reserved_tool_result_block.output, str):
1836                             reserved_tool_result_block.output += reminder
1837 
1838                         elif len(
1839                             reserved_tool_result_block.output,
1840                         ) > 0 and isinstance(
1841                             reserved_tool_result_block.output[-1],
1842                             TextBlock,
1843                         ):
1844                             reserved_tool_result_block.output[
1845                                 -1
1846                             ].text += reminder
1847 
1848                         else:
1849                             reserved_tool_result_block.output += [
1850                                 TextBlock(text=reminder),
1851                             ]
1852 
1853                     self._save_to_context([reserved_tool_result_block])
1854                     # Ends the tool call lifecycle.
1855                     self._update_tool_call_state(
1856                         tool_call.id,
1857                         ToolCallState.FINISHED,
1858                     )
1859                     # The ended event for the tool result
1860                     yield ToolResultEndEvent(
1861                         reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
1862                         tool_call_id=tool_call.id,
1863                         state=chunk.state,
1864                         metadata=chunk.metadata,
1865                     )
1866 
1867                 else:
1868                     # Intermediate ToolChunk — convert to streaming events
1869                     async for evt in self._convert_tool_chunk_to_event(
1870                         tool_call.id,
1871                         chunk.content,
1872                     ):
1873                         yield evt
1874 
1875             return
1876 
1877         raise ValueError(
1878             f"Invalid permission decision behavior: {decision.behavior}",
1879         )
1880

1882         self,
1883         tool_call: ToolCallBlock,
1884     ) -> AsyncGenerator["ToolChunk | ToolResponse", None]:
1885         """Raw tool execution entry point (maybe wrapped by middleware).
1886 
1887         This method is the hook point for ``on_acting`` middleware.  It
1888         delegates to :meth:`_acting_impl` which wraps
1889         ``toolkit.call_tool`` directly.  Permission checking and context
1890         writes are **not** part of this method — they are handled by
1891         :meth:`_execute_tool_call` before and after this call.
1892

1894             tool_call (`ToolCallBlock`):

1898             `ToolChunk | ToolResponse`:
1899                 Intermediate :class:`~agentscope.tool.ToolChunk` objects
1900                 followed by a final :class:`~agentscope.tool.ToolResponse`.

1902         if not self._acting_middlewares:
1903             async for item in self._acting_impl(tool_call):
1904                 yield item
1905         else:
1906 
1907             async def execute_chain(
1908                 index: int = 0,
1909                 tool_call: ToolCallBlock = tool_call,
1910             ) -> AsyncGenerator:
1911                 if index >= len(self._acting_middlewares):

1913                         yield item
1914                 else:
1915                     mw = self._acting_middlewares[index]
1916                     input_kwargs = {"tool_call": tool_call}

1918                     async def next_handler(**kwargs: Any) -> AsyncGenerator:
1919                         async for item in execute_chain(
1920                             index + 1,
1921                             **{**input_kwargs, **kwargs},
1922                         ):
1923                             yield item
1924 
1925                     async for item in mw.on_acting(
1926                         agent=self,
1927                         input_kwargs=input_kwargs,
1928                         next_handler=next_handler,
1929                     ):
1930                         yield item
1931 
1932             async for item in execute_chain():
1933                 yield item

2040     async def _split_context_for_compression(
2041         self,
2042         to_reserved_tokens: float,
2043         tools: list[dict],
2044     ) -> tuple[list[Msg], list[Msg]]:
2045         """Split context into parts to compress and parts to keep recent.
2046 
2047         Args:
2048             to_reserved_tokens (`float`):
2049                 The tokens to be reserved.
2050             tools (`list[dict]`):
2051                 The tools JSON schemas used for token counting.
2052 
2053         Returns:
2054             `tuple[list[Msg], list[Msg]]`:
2055                 The message objects to be compressed and reserved during
2056                 context compression.
2057         """
2058 
2059         # The system prompt
2060         system_msg = [
2061             SystemMsg(name="system", content=await self._get_system_prompt()),
2062         ]
2063 
2064         # Append the current summary if exists
2065         if self.state.summary:
2066             system_msg.append(
2067                 UserMsg("user", self.state.summary),
2068             )
2069 
2070         msg_index = len(self.state.context) - 1
2071         while msg_index >= 0:
2072             # Count the tokens when msgs after msg_index are reserved
2073             reserved_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2074                 system_msg + self.state.context[msg_index:],
2075                 tools,
2076             )
2077             # If reserved tokens exceed the limit
2078             if reserved_tokens >= to_reserved_tokens:
2079                 break
2080             msg_index -= 1
2081 
2082         if msg_index < 0:
2083             return [], deepcopy(self.state.context)
2084 
2085         # The msgs that won't exceed the reserved token limit
2086         msgs_to_compress = self.state.context[:msg_index]
2087         msgs_to_reserve = self.state.context[msg_index + 1 :]
2088         boundary_msg = self.state.context[msg_index]
2089 
2090         # Handle the boundary Msg
2091         boundary_msg_to_compress = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2092         boundary_msg_to_reserve = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2093 
2094         attempt_msg = deepcopy(boundary_msg)
2095 
2096         boundary_msg_content = boundary_msg.get_content_blocks()
2097         block_index = len(boundary_msg_content) - 1
2098         while block_index >= 0:
2099             attempt_msg.content = boundary_msg_content[block_index:]
2100 
2101             try_reserved = system_msg + [attempt_msg] + msgs_to_reserve
2102             reserved_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2103                 try_reserved,
2104                 tools,
2105             )
2106             if reserved_tokens > to_reserved_tokens:
2107                 break
2108             block_index -= 1
2109 
2110         # Adjust the block_index to avoid splitting tool call and result pairs.
2111         # Moving the boundary can bring another tool call into the compressed
2112         # part while leaving its result reserved, so repeat until it is stable.
2113         while True:
2114             # Check if the reserved part has tool results that don't have the
2115             # corresponding tool calls
2116             remain_result_ids = {}

2118                 len(boundary_msg_content) - 1,
2119                 block_index,
2120                 -1,

2131

2133             # because this move can split another tool call/result pair.
2134             block_index = max(remain_result_ids.values())
2135

2138             : block_index + 1
2139         ]

2141             block_index + 1 :
2142         ]

2145             msgs_to_compress += [boundary_msg_to_compress]

2148             msgs_to_reserve = [boundary_msg_to_reserve] + msgs_to_reserve

2178     async def _split_tool_result_for_compression(
2179         self,
2180         tool_result: ToolResultBlock,
2181     ) -> tuple[ToolResultBlock, ToolResultBlock | None]:
2182         """Split the tool result for compression.
2183 
2184         Args:
2185             tool_result (`ToolResultBlock`):
2186                 The tool result block.
2187 
2188         Returns:
2189             `tuple[ToolResultBlock, ToolResultBlock | None]`:
2190                 A tuple of the tool result blocks to reserved in context and
2191                 to offload (if any).
2192         """
2193         n_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2194             [AssistantMsg(self.name, content=tool_result.output)],
2195             None,
2196         )
2197 
2198         # Return the tool result without truncation
2199         if n_tokens <= self.context_config.tool_result_limit:
2200             return tool_result, None
2201 
2202         # Use a copied block for token counting
2203         copied_tool_result = deepcopy(tool_result)
2204 
2205         # Normalized into content blocks
2206         if isinstance(copied_tool_result.output, str):
2207             copied_tool_result.output = [
2208                 TextBlock(text=copied_tool_result.output),
2209             ]
2210 
2211         # Find the index of the block that will exceed the limit
2212         boundary_index = 0
2213         for i in range(len(copied_tool_result.output) - 1, 0, -1):
2214             copied_tool_result.output = tool_result.output[:i]
2215             cur_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2216                 [
2217                     AssistantMsg(
2218                         self.name,
2219                         content=copied_tool_result.output,
2220                     ),
2221                 ],
2222                 None,
2223             )
2224             if cur_tokens < self.context_config.tool_result_limit:
2225                 boundary_index = i
2226                 break
2227 
2228         # The blocks to reserve and offload (deep copy to avoid
2229         # modifying original)
2230         reserved_blocks: list = [
2231             deepcopy(b) for b in tool_result.output[:boundary_index]
2232         ]
2233         offload_blocks: list = [
2234             deepcopy(b) for b in tool_result.output[boundary_index + 1 :]
2235         ]
2236 
2237         # Get the boundary block, if text block, we can truncate it
2238         boundary_block = tool_result.output[boundary_index]
2239         if isinstance(boundary_block, TextBlock):
2240             # Truncate it
2241             truncated_text = boundary_block.text
2242             cur_tokens = await self.model.count_tokens(
2243                 [AssistantMsg(self.name, content=reserved_blocks)],
2244                 None,
2245             )
2246             cur_tokens_plus = await self.model.count_tokens(
2247                 [
2248                     AssistantMsg(
2249                         self.name,
2250                         content=reserved_blocks + [boundary_block],
2251                     ),
2252                 ],
2253                 None,
2254             )
2255             # Truncate the text by proportion of tokens
2256             token_delta = cur_tokens_plus - cur_tokens
2257             remaining_token_budget = (
2258                 self.context_config.tool_result_limit - cur_tokens
2259             )
2260             if token_delta <= 0:
2261                 reserved_tokens = (
2262                     len(truncated_text) if remaining_token_budget > 0 else 0
2263                 )
2264             else:
2265                 reserved_tokens = int(
2266                     remaining_token_budget / token_delta * len(truncated_text),
2267                 )
2268             reserved_tokens = max(
2269                 0,
2270                 min(len(truncated_text), reserved_tokens),
2271             )
2272 
2273             reserved_text = truncated_text[:reserved_tokens]
2274             offload_text = truncated_text[reserved_tokens:]
2275 
2276             if reserved_text:
2277                 if (
2278                     len(reserved_blocks) > 0
2279                     and reserved_blocks[-1].type == "text"
2280                 ):
2281                     reserved_blocks[-1].text += reserved_text
2282 
2283                 else:
2284                     reserved_blocks.append(
2285                         TextBlock(text=reserved_text, id=boundary_block.id),
2286                     )
2287 
2288             if offload_text:
2289                 if (
2290                     len(offload_blocks) > 0
2291                     and offload_blocks[0].type == "text"
2292                 ):
2293                     offload_blocks[0].text = (
2294                         offload_text + offload_blocks[0].text
2295                     )
2296 
2297                 else:
2298                     offload_blocks.insert(
2299                         0,
2300                         TextBlock(text=offload_text, id=boundary_block.id),
2301                     )
2302 
2303         else:
2304             # Drop the boundary block if inseparable
2305             offload_blocks.insert(0, boundary_block)
2306 
2307         if len(offload_blocks) == 0:
2308             return tool_result, None
2309 
2310         # Create new ToolResultBlock instances for reserved and offload
2311         reserved_tool_result = ToolResultBlock(
2312             id=tool_result.id,
2313             name=tool_result.name,
2314             output=reserved_blocks,
2315             state=tool_result.state,
2316         )
2317         offload_tool_result = ToolResultBlock(
2318             id=tool_result.id,
2319             name=tool_result.name,
2320             output=offload_blocks,
2321             state=tool_result.state,
2322         )
2323 
2324         return reserved_tool_result, offload_tool_result

2385         self,
2386         messages: list[Msg],
2387         tools: list[dict],
2388         tool_choice: ToolChoice | None = None,
2389     ) -> ChatResponse | AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, None]:
2390         """Perform model inference with retry logic and middleware support.
2391 
2392         Args:
2393             messages (`list[Msg]`):
2394                 The input messages to the model.
2395             tools (`list[dict]`):
2396                 The function schemas of the tools.
2397             tool_choice (`ToolChoice | None`, optional):
2398                 The tool choice strategy for the model call.
2399

2401             `ChatResponse | AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, None]`:
2402                 The model response, which can be a `ChatResponse` for
2403                 non-streaming models, or an async generator yielding
2404                 `ChatResponse` chunks for streaming models.

2406         models = [self.model]

2409         # retries

2413         last_exception = None
2414         # ``max_retries`` is the number of retries on top of the initial
2415         # call (mirrors ``ChatModelBase.max_retries``), so total attempts
2416         # per model is ``max_retries + 1``.
2417         for index, model in enumerate(models):
2418             if index > 0:
2419                 logger.info(
2420                     "Fallback to model '%s'",
2421                     model.model,
2422                 )
2423 
2424             for attempt in range(self.model_config.max_retries + 1):
2425                 try:
2426                     # Apply middleware to wrap the actual model() call
2427                     if not self._model_call_middlewares:
2428                         return await model(
2429                             messages=messages,
2430                             tools=tools,
2431                             tool_choice=tool_choice,
2432                         )
2433                     else:
2434                         # pylint: disable=cell-var-from-loop
2435                         async def execute_chain(
2436                             index: int = 0,
2437                             current_model: ChatModelBase = model,
2438                             messages: list[Msg] = messages,
2439                             tools: list[dict] = tools,
2440                             tool_choice: ToolChoice = tool_choice,
2441                         ) -> ChatResponse | AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, None]:
2442                             """Execute the model chain."""
2443                             if index >= len(self._model_call_middlewares):
2444                                 return await current_model(
2445                                     messages=messages,
2446                                     tools=tools,
2447                                     tool_choice=tool_choice,
2448                                 )
2449                             else:
2450                                 mw = self._model_call_middlewares[index]
2451                                 input_kwargs = {
2452                                     "current_model": current_model,
2453                                     "messages": messages,
2454                                     "tools": tools,
2455                                     "tool_choice": tool_choice,
2456                                 }
2457 
2458                                 async def next_handler(
2459                                     **kwargs: Any,
2460                                 ) -> (
2461                                     ChatResponse
2462                                     | AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, None]
2463                                 ):
2464                                     # pylint: disable=cell-var-from-loop
2465                                     return await execute_chain(
2466                                         index + 1,
2467                                         **{**input_kwargs, **kwargs},
2468                                     )
2469 
2470                                 return await mw.on_model_call(
2471                                     agent=self,
2472                                     input_kwargs=input_kwargs,
2473                                     next_handler=next_handler,
2474                                 )
2475 
2476                         return await execute_chain()
2477                 except Exception as e:

2480                     # next attempt left for this model. When ``max_retries=0``
2481                     # or the last retry has been used, the outer loop either
2482                     # falls over to the fallback or raises.
2483                     if attempt < self.model_config.max_retries:
2484                         logger.warning(
2485                             "Model %s call failed for agent %s. "
2486                             "Retrying (%d/%d)...",
2487                             model.model,

2497                             self.model_config.max_retries + 1,
2498                             self.name,
2499                         )

2539             | ToolResultBlock

2577             self.state.context.append(
2578                 AssistantMsg(
2579                     id=self.state.reply_id,
2580                     name=self.name,
2581                     content=persisted_blocks,
2582                     usage=msg_usage,

2616     def _check_next_action(
2617         self,
2618     ) -> (
2619         tuple[Literal["exit"], Msg]
2620         | tuple[Literal["reasoning"], None]
2621         | tuple[Literal["acting"], None]
2622     ):
2623         """Check the next action for the agent
2624 
2625         Awaiting tool calls:
2626             The tool calls waiting for the outside events (confirmation or
2627             external execution results, state = "asking" or "submitted")
2628         Executable tool calls:
2629             The tool calls allowed by the incoming confirmation events and
2630             haven't been executed yet (state = "allowed")
2631 
2632         The next action:
2633 
2634         |                          | Awaiting tool calls          | No awaiting tool call        |
2635         | ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
2636         | Executable tool calls    | Acting executable tool calls | Acting executable tool calls |
2637         | No executable tool calls | Exit the _reply              | Reasoning                    |
2638 
2639         Returns:
2640             `tuple[Literal["exit"], Msg]`:
2641                 If there is no executable tool call and there are awaiting tool
2642                 calls, which means the agent is waiting for the outside events
2643                 and should not do anything before that, the next action is to
2644                 exit the _reply and wait for the outside events.
2645             `tuple[Literal["reasoning"], None]`:
2646                 If there is no executable tool call and no awaiting tool call,
2647                 which means the agent has nothing to do in this iteration and
2648                 can continue reasoning for the next step.
2649             `tuple[Literal["acting"], None]`:
2650                 If there are executable tool calls, which means the agent can
2651                 act by executing the tool calls.
2652         """  # noqa: E501
2653         last_msg = self._get_last_msg()
2654         if last_msg is None:
2655             return "reasoning", None
2656 
2657         # In case wrong tool call state, first filter with the results
2658         finished_ids = {
2659             _.id for _ in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_result")
2660         }
2661         unfinished_tool_calls = [
2662             _
2663             for _ in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_call")
2664             if _.id not in finished_ids
2665         ]
2666 
2667         # Find if there are executable or awaiting tool calls
2668         awaiting_tool_calls: list[ToolCallBlock] = []
2669         executable_tool_calls: list[ToolCallBlock] = []
2670 
2671         confirming_names, asking_names = [], []
2672         for _ in unfinished_tool_calls:
2673             if _.state in [ToolCallState.PENDING, ToolCallState.ALLOWED]:
2674                 executable_tool_calls.append(_)
2675 
2676             elif _.state == ToolCallState.ASKING:
2677                 asking_names.append(_.name)
2678                 awaiting_tool_calls.append(_)
2679 
2680             elif _.state == ToolCallState.SUBMITTED:
2681                 confirming_names.append(_.name)
2682                 awaiting_tool_calls.append(_)
2683 
2684         if executable_tool_calls:
2685             return "acting", None
2686 
2687         if awaiting_tool_calls:
2688             # Prepare the message
2689             evt = ["I'm waiting for "]
2690             if asking_names:
2691                 evt += [
2692                     f"user confirmation for {len(asking_names)} tool calls",
2693                 ]
2694 
2695             if confirming_names:
2696                 if evt:
2697                     evt += [", and "]
2698                 evt += [
2699                     f"external execution results for {len(confirming_names)} "
2700                     f"tool calls",
2701                 ]
2702 
2703             text = "".join(evt) + "."
2704 
2705             return "exit", AssistantMsg(
2706                 name=self.name,
2707                 content=[TextBlock(text=text)],
2708             )
2709 
2710         return "reasoning", None

2712     def _get_executable_tool_calls(self) -> list[ToolCallBlock]:
2713         """Get tool calls from the last message that to be executed, which
2714         means we should reserve the tool calls that:
2715 
2716         1. doesn't have results yet, **and**
2717         2. haven't been submitted for external execution (state != "submitted")
2718         """
2719         last_msg = self._get_last_msg()
2720         if last_msg is None:
2721             return []
2722 
2723         # The tool results
2724         result_ids = {_.id for _ in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_result")}
2725         # The tool calls that doesn't have results yet
2726         tool_calls_wo_results = [
2727             _
2728             for _ in last_msg.get_content_blocks("tool_call")
2729             if _.id not in result_ids
2730         ]
2731 
2732         # Filter the ones that are "submitted", which already report the
2733         # external execution requirement
2734         pending_tool_calls = [
2735             _
2736             for _ in tool_calls_wo_results
2737             if _.state
2738             in [
2739                 ToolCallState.PENDING,
2740                 ToolCallState.ALLOWED,
2741             ]
2742         ]
2743         return pending_tool_calls

2745     async def _convert_chat_response_to_event(
2746         self,
2747         block_ids: dict,
2748         chunk: ChatResponse,
2749     ) -> AsyncGenerator:
2750         """Convert a ChatResponse chunk into a sequence of agent events. To
2751         keep the identifiers of the content blocks reasonable, the input
2752         blocks_ids is used to track the block ids.
2753 
2754         Args:
2755             block_ids (`dict`):
2756                 The block ids used to track the block generation.
2757             chunk (`ChatResponse`):
2758                 The chat response chunk to be converted.
2759         """
2760 
2761         # Classify the content blocks into different types
2762         text_blocks, thinking_blocks, tool_call_blocks = [], [], []
2763         data_blocks: list = []
2764         for block in chunk.content:
2765             if isinstance(block, TextBlock):
2766                 text_blocks.append(block)
2767             elif isinstance(block, ThinkingBlock):
2768                 thinking_blocks.append(block)
2769             elif isinstance(block, ToolCallBlock):
2770                 tool_call_blocks.append(block)
2771             elif isinstance(block, DataBlock):
2772                 data_blocks.append(block)
2773 
2774         # Handle the thinking stream: continue/open or close.
2775         # We only auto-close when the chunk also carries no data blocks;
2776         # a data-only chunk (e.g. an omni-style audio PCM delta) must keep
2777         # both text and thinking streams alive so the frontend doesn't
2778         # fragment one logical stream into many separate bubbles.
2779         if thinking_blocks:
2780             # Generate a new thinking block id and start event
2781             if not block_ids.get("thinking"):
2782                 block_ids["thinking"] = _generate_id()
2783                 yield ThinkingBlockStartEvent(
2784                     reply_id=self.state.reply_id,
2785                     block_id=block_ids["thinking"],
2786                 )
2787             # Generate the thinking delta event with the existing id
